# Zhangjie · dsh-qianlai
中文
A third-party small-business finance assistant plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
**Source integration candidate; no npm package or Release is published by this import.** Source snap
shot: `dad68cf856fae0bb2bb2ea954f6e9400a0e69098`. See the migration ledger, prior PR records, and im
cf856fae0bb2bb2ea954f6e9400a0e69098`. See the migration ledger, prior PR records, and import review.
## Scope
One local SQLite book per company; synthetic sample book, invoice consistency checks, bank-statement
import, opening balances, preview/confirmed posting, balances/profit, simple reports, closing, reve
rsals and CSV review export. Read XLS/XLSX and paginated PDF text/page images directly. An authentic
ated WeChat QR panel supports refresh and live status. Business events, material references and unve
rified notes support continuation across sessions sharing one local book; separate computers or DSH
homes do not synchronize. First binding attempts a resumable welcome with three bundled portraits. L
ive model and real-account delivery limits are recorded in validation notes. See package documentati
on. This does not replace an accountant or execute tax filing/payments. Model conversations and atta
chments use the configured external model/channel services.
## Build and validate
Use Node 22.x >=22.19 or Node >=24, and the declared pnpm 12.3.4.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
After building, install the absolute path of `packages/dsh-qianlai` through the DSH desktop plugin p
age or `dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/packages/dsh-qianlai`. Do not install the wor
kspace root. Use an isolated DSH_HOME. Workspace dependency distribution/npm installation is a separ
ate release milestone.
For local package inspection, `pnpm pack:all` builds both packages and uses pnpm's native recursive
pack to write `moneycome-fintax-core-0.1.0.tgz` and `dsh-qianlai-0.1.0.tgz` to the root `dist/` dire
ctory. The plugin archive declares the matching core version; a local archive consumer must resolve
it to the supplied core archive (for example using a package-manager override). This command does no
t publish either package or establish registry-install availability.
Then run `pnpm test:packages` to install those archives in a fresh temporary consumer with the core
override, keeping pnpm's default supply-chain protection. It checks tool loading, Chinese XLS/XLSX a
nd CSV reads, the WeChat export, and bundled SheetJS/license byte identity. It may fetch registry me
tadata/dependencies, disables install lifecycle scripts, uses no model or real account, and cleans i
ts consumer directory. SheetJS CE remains the existing official 0.20.3 build, bundled at compile tim
e instead of an exotic runtime URL dependency.
WeChat retries failed batches using stable message/request identities. Unacknowledged reply fragment
s are retained privately in `moneycome/wechat.json` and retried after reconnect/restart; acknowledge
d fragments are removed. This file contains credentials and pending business replies: never attach i
t publicly. Delivery still depends on the remote service's client-ID handling, and replies lost befo
re persistence cannot be recovered; do not rerun business actions merely to resend a reply.
[该节后续省略]
## Tests and contribution
The business regression plan and results (Chinese) include a runnable synthetic accounting flow, ind
ependent expected totals, channel scenarios and outstanding live acceptance.
The Q-008 reproduction kit includes fixed synthetic prompts, three frozen personas and selected visi
ble replies. Offline validation needs no key. Paid live-model runs are explicit and use only the tes
ter's DEEPSEEK_API_KEY environment variable. Never submit credentials, private conversations or real
KEY environment variable. Never submit credentials, private conversations or real financial records.
Follow CONTRIBUTING, the issue guide, and the existing PR template. Hosted CI is intentionally not e
nabled under the current maintenance rules; the historical workflow is archived as a non-workflow fi
le. Historical checks and this import's local results are distinguished.
Code uses Apache-2.0. Zhangjie artwork remains separately restricted to display inside this plugin;
retain NOTICE and asset notices. Community-maintained, not an official DeepSeek product. See maintai
ners, support, roadmap and security reporting.
